reasons: At most 4 MC per semester allows only one 4-MC course in each of semesters 4-8, giving 5 slots.
The request requires at least 8 courses: the seven must-take courses plus CS4278.
Prerequisites such as CS3230, CS2105, CS2107, CS3241 and CS3243 would add even more courses, so no feasible plan exists.
